signatures.description: Given a query hypergraph with join cardinalities and selectivity factors, implement a dynamic-programming join-order search that emits bushy trees, pruning connected subplans only when their estimated cost exceeds the best full plan found, and deferring disconnected subplans (cross products) until all connected pairs are exhausted, per the classic DPsize/DPccp distinction. The hard edge is memoizing on connected-component bitsets so that a subplan built by joining two disconnected components is never re-derived. Output the optimal plan and the count of explored subplans to make greedy-vs-DP cost regressions testable.
